technicalNotes:
When found in Audi A4/A5/Q5 (8K/8T/8R) models:
North American Market (NAR)  vehicles, see TPI 2033596/3 (or newer)
RoW vehicles, see TPI 2022372/2 (or newer)
When found in Audi TT 8J, the correct fuse location is fuse bank 1, position 12 (Looking down at the fuse box in the engine bay, bank 1 is the top bank and position 12 is the LH end fuse location)
